# Template: ceac
A cost-effectiveness acceptability curve (CEAC): the probability that each strategy is cost-effective (y, 0 to 1) against the willingness-to- pay threshold per QALY (x, in $1000s by default — `currency`, `thousands`, `x_min`/`x_max` set the money and the range), one smooth curve per strategy (typically the new treatment rising and the comparator falling, crossing where they are equally likely), a dashed 50% line, and dashed markers at conventional thresholds. Choose this scene for ANY request about CEACs, acceptability curves, probabilistic sensitivity analysis summaries, the probability a treatment is cost-effective, or willingness-to-pay thresholds per QALY. Every number here — a strategy's `midpoint` and `width`, the `thresholds` list, `x_max` — takes a typed value or a code element's variable via a "{id.var}" token, so a PSA run in Python can place the crossing itself. TYPE each strategy's `label` and `rising` by hand: a token supplies a number, never a name or a direction, and until the script has run the curves draw at their default crossing so the curve_i beats already exist.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "strategies": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 1,
   "maxItems": 3,
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "label": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "midpoint": {
      "oneOf": [
       {
        "type": "number",
        "description": "WTP (in $1000s) where this strategy's probability crosses 0.5 (default 30)."
       },
       {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\\}$"
       }
      ]
     },
     "width": {
      "oneOf": [
       {
        "type": "number",
        "description": "How gradually the curve turns, 4-40 (default 12)."
       },
       {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\\}$"
       }
      ]
     },
     "rising": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "true = probability rises with WTP (a more effective, costlier option); false = falls (default true)."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "label"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Default: a rising \"New treatment\" and a falling \"Standard care\" crossing at 30."
  },
  "thresholds": {
   "oneOf": [
    {
     "type": "array",
     "maxItems": 3,
     "items": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "description": "Dashed vertical markers at conventional WTP values in $1000s (default [30])."
    },
    {
     "type": "string",
     "pattern": "^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\\}$"
    }
   ]
  },
  "x_min": {
   "oneOf": [
    {
     "type": "number",
     "description": "Left end of the WTP axis, in the axis's units (default 0)."
    },
    {
     "type": "string",
     "pattern": "^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\\}$"
    }
   ]
  },
  "x_max": {
   "oneOf": [
    {
     "type": "number",
     "description": "Right end of the WTP axis, in the axis's units (default 100) — any value above x_min: 500 for a 500k threshold, 1000000 with thousands: false."
    },
    {
     "type": "string",
     "pattern": "^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\\}$"
    }
   ]
  },
  "currency": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "The money on the axis and the threshold captions (default \"$\"): a symbol (\"£\", \"€\") goes before the number, a word or code (\"kr\", \"NOK\") after it."
  },
  "thousands": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "true (default): the numbers are thousands (30 → \"$30k\", axis \"($1000s)\"); false: whole units (500000 → \"$500,000\")."
  },
  "x_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "The x-axis caption, replacing the default \"Willingness to pay per QALY ($1000s)\"."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with captions)
- half_line: dashed horizontal line at probability 0.5
- curve_<i>: the acceptability curve for strategies[i]
- curve_label_<i>: its label
- threshold_<i>: dashed vertical marker at thresholds[i] with its dollar caption
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a cost-effectiveness acceptability curve for a new treatment versus standard care." → params: {"title":"Acceptability curve"}
Request: "Show a CEAC where the new drug only becomes likely cost-effective above $50,000 per QALY." → params: {"strategies":[{"label":"New drug","midpoint":50},{"label":"Standard care","midpoint":50,"rising":false}],"thresholds":[30,50],"title":"An expensive drug"}

In YAML: `template: ceac` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
